output_list.criticism: The mint function has an integer overflow, allowing the owner to set the balance of an arbitrary user to any value.
The unpause function does not check the caller's access rights, allowing any user to unlock the balance of the owner.
The foreignBuy function has an integer overflow, allowing the owner to set the balance of an arbitrary user to any value.
The withdraw function does not check the caller's access rights, allowing any user to access the balance of the owner.
